shared_elements: figures with limbs rendered in low relief/carved line
long straight lines or band-like divisions crossing the surface
possible schematic animal or anthropomorphic forms
justification: Both surfaces carry carved figural motifs with limbs plus long straight linear elements dividing the field, but that is about as generic as figural carving gets. A shows recognisable naturalistic creatures in profile (quadrupeds in a row, a long-necked bird, a scorpion-like arthropod) organised in horizontal registers above and below a patterned band, whereas B shows only angular, stick-like schematic forms with no identifiable species, attributes or register structure.
